description: Implementation of the TransformFeedbackGL class methods for managing OpenGL transform feedback objects within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TransformFeedbackGL
classes.description: Class managing OpenGL transform feedback objects, including starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and binding buffers.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts transform feedback with specified primitive mode.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends transform feedback and makes results visible.

methods.name: bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a specific index for transform feedback.

methods.name: getTransformFeedbackID
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the transform feedback object.

methods.name: syncActiveState
methods.description: Synchronizes the active state of the transform feedback object.

methods.name: syncPausedState
methods.description: Synchronizes the paused state of the transform feedback object.
